result.title: CircuitTree: Composing Circuits into A Syllable Transcriber
result.summary: The goal of circuit discovery is to decompose a monolithic neural network into tiny modular subnetworks which are interpretable in the sense that each does an identifiable subtask. We develop a practical method for composing arbitrarily many circuits into a single model. We propose a greedy, density-scaled composition algorithm that overcomes limitations of previous attempts to compose circuits by naive union, then generalize it to $N$ circuits via CircuitTree, a new data structure built on a $Θ(N\log N)$ tree-compose schedule. We compose circuits pruned from HuBERT for classifying individual phonemes into a syllable classifier, a capability none of the 39 phoneme circuits has individually. Chaining CircuitTrees into a hierarchy-of-circuits pipeline, we transcribe open syllables at 64.8\% accuracy, within 1.2 points of a 66.0\% ceiling that shares no circuitry at all, with 99.5\% of circuit components shared.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 CircuitTree：先用贪心、密度缩放的组合算法替代朴素并集来合并多个电路，再以 Θ(N log N) 的树式组合调度推广到 N 个电路，将 HuBERT 中剪枝出的音素电路组合成单音节分类器，并串联为层次化电路流水线完成开音节转写。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「把若干各自只做子任务的子网络组合出新的整体能力、并大量共享组件」的做法，可能为 LVR 中组合与复用 latent 推理子技能、分析共享计算提供可核查的方法线索，但任务属语音且未涉及视觉推理状态，需人工判断迁移性。
